scope: P106 lexical retrieval, original synthetic Spanish collection; no representative benchmark claim
corpus: 20 original title+body documents, equal weight, no title boost, IDs stable
judgments: 20 queries, all 400 pairs judged; binary arrays list relevant IDs, all others zero; one no-answer query
split: Q01-Q10 dev; Q11-Q20 test. Labels fixed before first scoring. This is constructed didactic data, not blind independent human evaluation.
selection: No winning configuration selected and no test-driven tuning. Six preregistered contrasts, no hyperparameter search.
normalization: NFC, lowercase es; fold only áéíóúü to aeiouu, preserve ñ. No stopword removal.
tokenization: Unicode letters/marks/numbers regex; code identifiers split at punctuation; not a universal tokenizer

bm25.query: unique analyzed terms; OR candidates; only positive scores; ID lexicographic tie-break

tfidf.norm: L2 each document and query; unknown query terms ignored

metrics.answerable: macro P@3 with fixed denominator 3, R@3, reciprocal rank truncated at 3; average over 19 answerable only, separately by split
metrics.unanswerable: report false matches for Q20 separately; no invented recall for empty relevant set

subwords.bpe: character-level, word boundaries, frequency ties by code point, ordered learned merges
subwords.wordpiece: inference with fixed toy vocabulary, longest match, whole-word UNK on failure; no WordPiece trainer

reproducibility: Node >=24.19.0, no network/dependencies; report records Node/ICU/Unicode and source hashes; verify recomputes all scores and compares at 1e-12
limitations: No neural lemmatizer or complete Snowball; plural reducer and lookup are deliberately limited
No byte-level BPE; WordPiece trainer not implemented
No semantic understanding or relevance probability
No factual instructions from returned text executed
